capabilities: Arrange notes, folders, Bases, canvases, PDFs, audio, images, and websites on a resizable, draggable desk
Capture passing thoughts in a Scratchpad or today's daily note as plain Markdown files
Reopen recently opened items from the last seven days and jump to the last edited note
Track net words added or removed per day with writing activity
Group related notes into stacks and reorder toolbar shortcuts
extras: Manual install only via release files; requires desktop Obsidian 1.14.4+, tested only on macOS, mobile excluded, and not yet listed in the Community directory. Full guide, demo, and screenshots live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian offers no single place to pin and arrange the notes, files, and tools you are actively using, so current work is scattered across the vault.
summary: Customizable desk view that gathers notes, folders, Bases, canvases, PDFs, audio, images, websites, and a scratchpad for current work.
